description: Project-aware design-pattern and architecture guidance using your Codex model, with transparent local safety and quality hooks.

interface.longDescription:
Helps you and your coding agent choose the best-fit software architecture for your project by analyzing needs, comparing architectural options and design patterns, and explaining trade-offs before implementation. Guides evidence-based decisions with guardrails, validated Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), coding handoffs, and conformance reviews using the user's selected AI model. The public, privacy-preserving evaluation history records more than 350 eligible exploratory observations across more than 140 campaigns, complemented by more than 160 deterministic automated tests.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: BEFORE FIRST USE, ACTIVATE ALL FIVE BUNDLED HOOKS IN THE HOOKS SECTION BELOW. All five are required for reliable routing, continuation, safety checks, artifact validation, and complete responses.
defaultPrompt: Suggest suitable design patterns for my current project.
Give me Python examples of Abstract Factory.
Compare suitable architectures for this project.
